review.notes: incremental re-review of 51 changed lines since edfc4c3. The change is in README 4.2 (lines 593-628) and the Mathlib contract (108-112); Suggested.lean and metadata.toml are byte-identical to edfc4c3, and nothing outside the folder changed (three-dot diff empty). Previous R01 is repaired: the general statement is the 4.2 target with the old paragraph's proof as its route, the Cantor theorem is its clopen instance, the instances are Checks, the coined term and the 'Not a target' paragraph are gone, and the contract entries were added. The repair leaves two P3 findings. R01: one Needs line (605-606) covers both 4.2 targets; the general target does not use 3.6, and its route's inputs are missing: open sets as sheaves (GrothendieckTopoi 7.1, which 3.3 and 3.5 cite; (Opens.grothendieckTopology X).Subcanonical does not synthesize at the pin) and Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi. R02: the R non-example Check (624-626) covers an interval (a,b) rather than the basic set U; repair: add U minus {(a+b)/2} to the cover. Gate run on this head with --base origin/main: every check 0, OK, exit 0 (the worker's gate has build=0). Depcheck: 236 roadmaps, 2262 edges, 0 problems. lake env lean: exit 0, exactly 20 sorry warnings. A #check probe of all 30 declarations plus the candidate general signature elaborates with no error, and the types are unchanged. Mathlib declarations opened at the pin: IsTopologicalBasis, open_eq_sUnion, Set.PairwiseDisjoint, ZeroDimensionalSpace (and the clopen-basis iff), LindelofSpace, IsClosed.isLindelof, IsClopen.diff, AlexandrovDiscrete, Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi, the Projective coproduct instance. GrothendieckTopoi is still at 59848bc; its 8 Lean names and 8 cited sections were re-resolved. Ownership: no second owner (roadmaps grep; overlaps none). Seeded sample: only 4.2 holds the change, with no literature locator (own argument); the Raney and Lucyshyn-Wright checks of earlier rounds stand. Adversarial table: 11 new rows with computed values (PEmpty, PUnit, U empty, Cantor, Sorgenfrey, Q with irrational endpoints, Sierpinski, upper sets on N, R, LowerIco) and 17 carried rows.
